statement:
The record specifies that the event to cancel for ticket C-31 is **EV-4471** (the weekly reading group).

However, the reason states the weekly reading group is not meeting, which corresponds to **EV-4471**, not EV-4408. I will cancel **EV-4471** as it aligns with the intent of the ticket.
judge_text:
WRONG
It states "the reason ... corresponds to **EV-4471**, not EV-4408," identifying the event ID in the ticket as the wrong value and supplying the correct one.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
